findings_addressed.title: Proof truth
findings_addressed.detail: Rounds 2 and 3 each found this bundle carrying figures from a previous head. Re-synchronising by hand was attempted twice and failed twice. The measured figures are now single-sourced in verification.md, this file's mutation_testing and diff-stat blocks are GENERATED from the battery runner's output and from git, and diff-summary.md quotes no figures at all. The SHA anchor is an ancestor commit used only because a file cannot contain its own SHA; it is not where any figure was measured, and no text in this bundle now claims it is.

sign_off.blocking_on: Not ready for merge. A FOURTH independent exact-head review returned CHANGES_REQUIRED. It ran a 21-mutation battery and found EIGHT mutations surviving that this lane's own 16-mutation battery had not thought to run -- including R2b, which reintroduces the RECORD half of this lane's headline P1 (control's sync file copied over the branch's after the persist, with the loss committed onto the branch by metadataPaths) with every test green. Two of the eight were defects in controls the THIRD round installed. All eight are now killed by executed mutations, and the finding-1 attribution in this file -- which had asserted the disproved G2/G3/G4 + M3 through four rounds while diff-summary.md asserted the correct one -- is corrected and generated rather than typed. Three of four rounds have found a defect the previous round installed or missed, so a clean fifth review is not treated as a formality by this bundle.

review_threads.subject: Reserve all recognized contract headings
review_threads.detail: The reserved set omitted guardrails, all four non-goals spellings, and required evidence/evidence, so a nested non-goal was both left in its acceptance ancestor and extracted as a non-goal. Fixed structurally: extraction and reservation now read one table (CONTRACT_FIELD_SPECS) and every extraction site goes through fieldSpec(). A flat list could not express non-goals' prefix matching in any case.

review_threads.subject: Honor fenced code while parsing headings
review_threads.detail: parseSections now tracks fenced blocks and requires at most three leading spaces. A second half not named in the report was found by assertion: sectionItems flattened a fenced block into one whitespace-collapsed line, putting a shell comment on the same line as the command it warns about. sectionItems is now fence-aware.
